summary.text: Joe Picozzi is a Republican who represents Northeast Philadelphia's 5th Senate District and, according to his biography, is the first Republican elected to represent Philadelphia in the State Senate since 1996.

paragraphs.text: Picozzi was born and raised in Somerton and resides in Tacony; he is the son of a Philadelphia firefighter and a special education teacher.

He graduated from Georgetown University in 2017 and from Holy Ghost Preparatory School, is an Eagle Scout, and was appointed to the Philadelphia Youth Commission by City Councilman Brian O'Neill. Before running for office he was chief of staff at the Manhattan Institute and an aide to Kevin McCarthy.
His listed legislative priorities are public safety, neighborhood quality of life and education.
